segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the renewal and the additional seats for the operations team. You’re at 48 seats today, and you mentioned moving to 62 starting September 1, right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. We have 11 coordinators and 3 supervisors joining the workflow. I need the quote to show 62 total, not a separate add-on line if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can do that. The annual term would run September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027. At 62 seats, the pricing sheet puts you at $84 per seat per month, billed annually. That’s $62,496 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And can the invoice go to ap@northlakeparts.com with net 30? Last year it went to my inbox and I had to forward it around.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: For sure. I’ll set the billing contact as AP and keep you as the business contact. Net 30 is already on your account, so no change there.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. We also need the onboarding session for the new supervisors before go-live. August 26 or 27 would work.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, we can include one 90-minute enablement session on August 27 at 1 p.m. Central. I’ll put that in the order form so it’s clear, and our customer team will send the calendar invite after signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. One more thing, legal asked if the auto-renewal language is the same as the current agreement.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It is the same: 30-day notice before the end of term. I’ll attach the current terms with the renewal order so they can compare. No new data processing terms, no change to service levels.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That should be fine. Send it over today and I’ll route it to procurement. If there aren’t any surprises, we can sign by next Friday, August 9.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send the order form for 62 seats, $62,496 annually, net 30, September 1 start, and the August 27 training session. You’ll have it in about an hour.
